args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following deployment of v2.3.1, with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Mitigation: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: all regions now running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back down to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 regression still under investigation; note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to promotion.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback**
- Identified v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) as unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
- Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Verified post-rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate back down to **0.2%**.

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, paged on-call, describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification. I noted that v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before promotion, which is a useful lead for the root-cause investigation.
